scope: Real YOLOX Nano/Tiny/S, loopback fake API, video camera and controlled voice. No paid API, physical camera, accuracy, identity, walking or human acceptance claim.
limitation: Static image video measures transport/inference latency only; temporal video without independent annotation does not establish tracking quality.
cases: CA-H1: initial Luna dispatch occurs while real local worker initialization is gated; opt-in defaults off
CA-H1: real local inference continues for at least four accepted frames while controlled speech remains active
CA-H1/H2: one camera, zero local frame queue and at least four accepted real detector frames during 12 s pending fake API
CA-H9: disable cancels initialization and prevents late ready/results
CA-H9: stop cancels initialization and prevents late ready/results
CA-H9: consent cancels initialization and prevents late ready/results

metrics.inferenceBasis: aggregate; inferenceByProvider groups worker results by their reported backend
